# openssh — 2018 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 3 openssh CVEs of 2018 are in `data/cve/vendors/openssh/2018.jsonl`.

### CVE-2018-15473
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2018-08-17 | Updated: 2025-12-17 | Max CVSS: 5.9
- CWE: n/a; CWE-362 CWE-362 Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization ('Race Condition')
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 5.9 MEDIUM `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial
- Exploit-DB 45233: OpenSSH 2.3 < 7.7 - Username Enumeration (remote/linux, 2018-08-21, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 45210: OpenSSH 2.3 < 7.7 - Username Enumeration (PoC) (remote/linux, 2018-08-16, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 45939: OpenSSH < 7.7 - User Enumeration (2) (remote/linux, 2018-12-04, verified=0)

OpenSSH through 7.7 is prone to a user enumeration vulnerability due to not delaying bailout for an invalid authenticating user until after the packet containing the request has been fully parsed, related to auth2-gss.c, auth2-hostbased.c, and auth2-pubkey.c.

### CVE-2018-15919
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2018-08-28 | Updated: 2025-12-18 | Max CVSS: 5.3
- CWE: n/a; CWE-200 CWE-200 Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 5.3 MEDIUM `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

Remotely observable behaviour in auth-gss2.c in OpenSSH through 7.8 could be used by remote attackers to detect existence of users on a target system when GSS2 is in use. NOTE: the discoverer states 'We understand that the OpenSSH developers do not want to treat such a username enumeration (or "oracle") as a vulnerability.'

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a
